contentEn:
A whole house renovation in Port Moody, BC costs between $150,000 and $600,000+ in 2026, depending on scope and condition. A partial whole-house project runs $150,000–$300,000, a full renovation reaches $300,000–$500,000, and a comprehensive rebuild or luxury finish lands at $500,000–$600,000+. These figures are drawn from actual Reno Stars project costs across Metro Vancouver and the Tri-Cities area.

Cost by Renovation Scope

Renovation TypeCost RangeWhat Is Included
Partial whole-house$150,000 – $300,000Selective room renovations, kitchen or bathrooms, flooring, some systems updates
Full renovation$300,000 – $500,000Complete interior strip, all rooms renovated, new kitchen, multiple bathrooms, flooring, electrical and plumbing updates
Luxury comprehensive$500,000 – $600,000+Full gut, custom finishes, structural work, premium fixtures throughout, layout changes

What Drives Costs in Port Moody

Port Moody homes range from 1970s–1980s ranches and townhouses in neighborhoods like Glenwood Centre and College Park to newer developments around Newport Village and Harbour Centre. Older homes in Port Moody frequently need full electrical and plumbing system upgrades, which add $20,000–$50,000 to the project. Heritage-era homes may also require special finishing requirements that increase costs by 10–20 percent.

Material selection drives the largest cost variable. Standard finishes run $50–$100 per square foot for flooring and surfaces. Premium finishes — wide-plank hardwood, quartzite countertops, custom millwork — run $100–$250 per square foot. A full kitchen renovation alone typically ranges $35,000–$120,000 depending on cabinetry and appliance selection. Each additional bathroom adds $14,000–$85,000 based on scope.

Real Metro Vancouver Whole-House Project Examples

Reno Stars has completed whole-house renovations across Metro Vancouver. A whole-house renovation in Vancouver included bathroom updates and comprehensive flooring replacement throughout the home. A custom whole-house project in Vancouver featured complete interior design with premium finishes. A Richmond house renovation covered the kitchen, multiple bathrooms and new flooring throughout. A whole-home renovation in Richmond showcased a marble-look kitchen with premium fixtures across the full interior. These examples demonstrate the range of scopes and budgets available to Port Moody homeowners.

Timeline: How Long Does a Whole-House Renovation Take?

  • Partial whole-house: 3–6 months
  • Full renovation: 6–10 months
  • Luxury comprehensive: 10–16 months

Do You Need a Permit in Port Moody?

Whole-house renovations in Port Moody typically require a building permit, especially for any structural changes, electrical panel upgrades, or plumbing re-routing. The City of Port Moody requires permits for renovations that alter the structure, change the use or occupancy of a space, or involve new construction. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of the project management scope.

A full whole-house renovation in Port Moody typically includes complete interior strip, all room renovations, new kitchen, multiple bathroom updates, flooring replacement, and electrical and plumbing system updates. 高贵林港（Port Moody）整体房屋装修费用在2026年介于$150,000至$600,000以上，具体取决于工程范围和房屋状况。局部整体装修为$150,000至$300,000，全面装修为$300,000至$500,000，豪华精装或重建则高达$500,000至$600,000以上。这些数据基于聚星装修在温哥华都会区和三联市地区的实际工程费用。

按装修范围的费用明细

装修类型费用范围包含项目
局部整体装修$150,000 – $300,000选择性房间装修、厨房或浴室、地板、部分系统更新
全面装修$300,000 – $500,000室内全面拆除、所有房间装修、新厨房、多间浴室、地板、电气和管道更新
豪华精装$500,000 – $600,000+全面拆除、定制饰面、结构工程、全屋高端五金、布局改动

高贵林港装修费用上涨的主要原因

高贵林港的住宅类型多样，从Glenwood Centre和College Park地区1970至1980年代的平房和联排别墅，到Newport Village和Harbour Centre周边的新开发住宅不等。区内老旧住宅通常需要全面的电气和管道系统升级，额外费用约$20,000至$50,000。历史遗留住宅可能还需要特殊饰面要求，费用增加10至20个百分点。

材料选择是最大的成本变量。标准饰面装修费用为每平方尺$50至$100。高端饰面（宽板实木地板、石英岩台面、定制木作）为每平方尺$100至$250。仅厨房装修一项通常介于$35,000至$120,000之间，具体取决于橱柜和电器选择。每增加一间浴室，根据范围不同，额外费用为$14,000至$85,000。

温哥华都会区整体房屋工程案例

聚星装修已在温哥华都会区完成多个整体房屋装修工程。温哥华一个整体房屋装修包含浴室更新和全屋地板更换。温哥华一个定制整体项目配备了全面室内设计和高端饰面。列治文一个房屋装修覆盖了厨房、多间浴室和全屋新地板。列治文一个全屋装修展示了大理石纹厨房和全屋高端五金。这些案例展示了高贵林港业主可选择的工程范围和预算级别。

工期：整体房屋装修需要多长时间？

  • 局部整体装修：3至6个月
  • 全面装修：6至10个月
  • 豪华精装：10至16个月

高贵林港需要许可证吗？

高贵林港整体房屋装修通常需要建筑许可证，特别是涉及结构改动、电气面板升级或管道改线时。高贵林港市要求对改变结构、改变空间用途或涉及新建筑的装修申请许可证。聚星装修作为工程管理的一部分，处理所有许可证申请。

高贵林港局部整体房屋装修起价为$150,000至$300,000。全面装修为$300,000至$500,000。带定制饰面和结构工程的豪华精装项目可达$500,000至$600,000或以上（2026年）。

高贵林港全面整体房屋装修通常包括室内全面拆除、所有房间装修、新厨房、多间浴室更新、地板更换以及电气和管道系统更新。局部装修根据业主优先事项覆盖选定的房间和系统。

高贵林港局部整体房屋装修需3至6个月。全面装修需6至10个月。带结构改动和定制精装的项目需10至16个月。

聚星装修是否承接高贵林港的整体房屋装修？
